permit.applies: The performer applies online to the Immigration Division, with a letter from a sponsor in the Solomon Islands.
permit.first: A sponsor's letter and a letter of support from the Ministry's Director of Communication giving the performance locations and the sponsor (for film work, the Director of the Government Communication Unit's approval letter).
permit.eligibility: This visa is for musicians or bands visiting the Solomon Islands to perform for commercial purposes such as concerts, gigs, or promotional events.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Entertainer Visa: Musician (Commercial)
sources.said: This visa is for musicians or bands visiting the Solomon Islands to perform for commercial purposes such as concerts, gigs, or promotional events. Key Details Visa fee: $400 USD Online fee: $50 USD Permitted stay: 60 days Valid for: Up to 2 years Entry option: Multiple … Extension: available re-application required Work rights: Permitted (entertainment-specific) Visa Requirements Submit copy of Passport biopage. Letter from sponsor. Copy of return ticket. … Applicants must submit a Letter of Support from the relevant Ministry Director of Communication , including details of performance locations and sponsor.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Entertainer Visa: Film-maker (Commercial)
sources.said: This visa is for professional filmmakers undertaking commercial film projects in the Solomon Islands, such as documentaries, advertisements, or feature films intended for public or paid distribution. Key Details Visa fee: $400 USD Online fee: $50 USD Permitted stay: 60 days Valid for: Up to 2 years … Extension: visa renewable … Submit approval letter from the Director of Solomon Islands Government Communication Unit. Letter from sponsor. … Professional film producers, directors, and production crew engaged in commercial film work .

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, Working Resident Visa: Short-Term Employment
sources.said: The processing time may vary for different visa categories, there is no specific timeframe, however all applications will be processed when registered in our system.

blockers.sought: The Immigration Division's decision time for the Entertainer Visa
